bundle.shortDescription: Your existing dev tools. One persistent workspace.
bundle.longDescription: ToolOnize discovers the launchers already on your machine without running them, lets you review them, and organizes terminals, SSH/tmux sessions and GUI tools into persistent docking workspaces. Local-first: no account, no cloud, no telemetry. A CRMonize.com open-source project.
